input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: A pkill -f with the bracketed name also present elsewhere in the same command was refused by the hook, which silently dropped a heredoc test append in the same call; noticed from the test count and redone.
integrity_issues: The open-tennis-robots auditor described the surviving bumper mutant as letting the robot pivot into an obstacle; tick() re-zeroes forward drive in the same loop, so it is a test gap, not an unguarded hazard. Corrected in the audit file with a lead's note and in the post.

doc_friction.issue: The sensing-epigate brief I wrote guessed 'epi' meant epidemiology from the slug; it is epipolar geometry. The auditor caught it. A one-line README read before briefing would have avoided it; sample could print each subject's README title.

The open-tennis-robots test step rewrites the tracked src/tennisbots.egg-info/PKG-INFO, which voids that workflow and portfolio-pages in every local sweep (UNSTABLE CHECKOUT). The egg-info should be untracked or the step should not reinstall in place.
The Stop hook asks to commit untracked files while a subagent is still writing its audit file; committing an interim audit then needed a second commit.

deviations.why: Step 4 says fix in its own commit with a test; for open-tennis-robots the bumper mutant was caught only after strengthening the test to assert the handler never issues forward drive, since tick() masks it.
deviations.did: Asserted the forward command never appears in the hardware log.
deviations.result: The mutant is now caught; the full 258-test suite passes.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
